desc: Stormwing: the fast skirmisher that never touches the ground. Units: seconds, metres, hp.
name: Stormwing

look.why: barely bigger: the wings carry the silhouette

shell_why: x0.8: the most fragile shell, it makes up for it with speed

baseline.why: run-speed bonus by weight class (a light hero keeps the most speed; merge cap +40%)

dash.why: each dodge crackles: a burst that arcs on to a second foe

lmb.name: Chain Bolt
lmb.desc: Fire fast lightning bolts. Each bolt that hits arcs on to one more foe.

rmb.name: Hover
rmb.desc: Hold to hover with a slow fall. Cross gaps in the ground while it lasts. Ends when you let go or run out.
rmb.why: falls at 1.2 m/s, hovers up to 3.5s per charge, 4.5 m/s hop when started on the ground; 'full' when the lift has settled at 0.6s

e.name: Storm Blink
e.desc: Blink forward through foes, shocking everything along the path. Two charges.
e.why: 7.5m, 2 charges, 4.5s each; swept in 0.5m steps so walls stop it and nothing is skipped

r.name: Thunderhead
r.desc: Rise into a darkening cloud ring, then strike every foe within 10m.
r.why: 0.7s rise with a 10m darkening ring, then one strike per foe
